brightness_definition: Rec.709 weighted encoded sRGB, range 0..1; not linear luminance
switch_definition: state differs across an observed adjacent requested source-step pair; pixels must be supported on both sides of the pair
regional_summary: sum switched pixel-pairs / sum eligible pixel-pairs
units: per observed source-step pair; not seconds or calibrated degrees

whole_stone_reference.definition: median encoded brightness on fixed common registered stone support
